{"id":"mimid-7yn7.5","title":"Content coverage: the user-facing half, thinner than the transport half","description":"Mark, 2026-11-22. Where mandated interop VISIBLY fails for users: not
refused messages, but messages that arrive as "unsupported content".

| Gap | Where it stands |
|---|---|
| Read receipts / message status | mimid-1wgh.11.11, deferred, "adopt later" |
| AV metadata | mimid-1wgh.14.1, deferred |
| Voice and video calls | largely outside mimi-content; a core feature of every app on the list |
| Typing, polls, location, stickers | not in content-10 |
| Attachments at volume | proxyDownload exists; Haven lists assets_ohttp unsupported |

Two of these are already beads deferred by decision (mimid-1wgh.44.31
and .44.46 respectively), which was the right call for a reference
implementation talking to one friendly peer. Under a mandate the
calculation changes, because a user who sees "unsupported content" does
not care which draft was unfinished.

Calls are the sharpest case: they are a core feature of every messenger
on the gatekeeper list and largely NOT in mimi-content, so this is a
specification gap rather than a mimid backlog item. Worth knowing before
anyone promises a date.

NOTE this is the group most affected by the decision on mimid-7yn7.1. A
conformance implementation needs to DECODE and JUDGE content, which
mimid largely does; it does not need to render a sticker. If Mark picks
the conformance path, most of this table stops being blocking.","status":"open","priority":2,"issue_type":"task","owner":"mark@reviewcommit.com","created_at":"2026-11-23T03:52:06.094870888Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","updated_at":"2026-11-23T03:52:06.094870888Z","labels":["human"],"dependencies":[{"issue_id":"mimid-7yn7.5","depends_on_id":"mimid-7yn7","type":"parent-child","created_at":"2026-11-23T03:52:06.24464373Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"},{"issue_id":"mimid-7yn7.5","depends_on_id":"mimid-7yn7.1","type":"blocks","created_at":"2026-11-23T03:54:07.526453364Z","created_by":"Mark Atwood","metadata":"{}"}]}
new_value: {"notes":"BLOCKED BY mimid-7yn7.1 on purpose (Mark deferred that decision 2026-11-22). The content list is the work the two paths disagree about, so starting it would choose the full-provider path by default without saying so. Do the shared blockers first; see mimid-7yn7.1 for the split and the revisit triggers."}

new_value: {"notes":"UNBLOCKED 2026-11-22: the dependency on mimid-7yn7.1 is removed, because that decision turned out to be a false trade (see its notes). The content list is ordinary prioritised work competing on merit, not gated on a strategy question. Two of its rows remain deferred by their own earlier decisions (mimid-1wgh.11.11 by mimid-1wgh.44.31, mimid-1wgh.14.1 by mimid-1wgh.44.46), and calls remain largely a specification gap rather than a backlog item."}

new_value: {"notes":"2026-11-23: the calls row has a concrete shape now. mimi-content does have a 'session' disposition and §4.5 ExternalPart, and mimid already maps that to a JMAP VTC MessageAction both ways (project.rs:202-210, backend.rs:872-893). What is missing upstream is the semantics around it -- what a receiver does with a session part it cannot join, whether it is content or a live endpoint, lifetime, which schemes are meaningful, and any ringing or declining states. Never raised with the WG; see mimid-1wgh.37.106. Our own binding draft does not specify the mapping either: mimid-bcji."}
